// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/client-dashboard/ClientForm.tsx =====

// ===== FILE: src/core/components/client/ClientForm.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { FaMapMarkerAlt, FaExclamationTriangle, FaSave, FaStickyNote } from 'react-icons/fa';

import { useClientMutation } from '@/core/client/hooks/useClientMutation';
import { Client, AddressType } from '@/core/client/types/client';
import { ClientFormSchema, ClientFormInput } from '@/core/client/schemas/clientSchema';

interface ClientFormProps {
    client?: Client;
    onSuccess: (savedClient: Client) => void;
    showSubmitButton?: boolean;
}

/**
 * @component ClientForm
 * @description Formulário Headless (Puro) de Cliente.
 * * 🏆 PADRÃO DE QUALIDADE CLASSE OURO:
 * 1. Single Source of Truth: Consome o `ClientFormSchema` (Zod) garantindo que as regras
 * de validação do CRM sejam matematicamente idênticas às da tela de Master Data.
 * 2. UX de Resiliência (Tratamento 409): Intercepta erros de "Documento Duplicado" 
 * e acopla o erro diretamente no input do usuário, em vez de um alerta genérico.
 * 3. HTML5 Nativo: Permite submissão externa via `form="client-edit-form"`, viabilizando
 * layouts complexos como a Workstation do CRM.
 */
export const ClientForm: React.FC<ClientFormProps> = ({ 
    client, 
    onSuccess, 
    showSubmitButton = true 
}) => {
    
    const { createClient, updateClient, isLoading } = useClientMutation();
    const isEditing = !!client;
    
    // Estado para erros genéricos (ex: 500 do servidor)
    const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    // =========================================================================
    // 🧠 MOTOR DO FORMULÁRIO (RHF + Zod)
    // =========================================================================
    const {
        register,
        handleSubmit,
        reset,
        setError,
        formState: { errors }
    } = useForm<ClientFormInput & { address?: any }>({
        resolver: zodResolver(ClientFormSchema as any),
        mode: 'onChange'
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 💧 HIDRATAÇÃO DOS DADOS
    // =========================================================================
    useEffect(() => {
        if (client) {
            // Busca o endereço principal (se houver) para popular os campos
            const mainAddress = client.addresses?.find(a => a.type === AddressType.MAIN) || client.addresses?.[0];
            
            reset({
                id: client.id,
                name: client.name,
                document: client.document || '',
                email: client.email || '',
                phone: client.phone || '',
                userNotes: client.userNotes || '',
                isActive: client.isActive,
                address: {
                    id: mainAddress?.id || '',
                    street: mainAddress?.street || '',
                    number: mainAddress?.number || '',
                    district: mainAddress?.district || '',
                    city: mainAddress?.city || '',
                    state: mainAddress?.state || '',
                    zipCode: mainAddress?.zipCode || ''
                }
            });
        } else {
            // Estado virgem para criação
            reset({
                name: '',
                document: '',
                email: '',
                phone: '',
                userNotes: '',
                isActive: true,
                address: { street: '', number: '', district: '', city: '', state: '', zipCode: '' }
            });
        }
    }, [client, reset]);

    // =========================================================================
    // ⚙️ HANDLER DE SUBMISSÃO E TRATAMENTO DE ERROS
    // =========================================================================
    const onSubmitForm = async (data: any) => {
        setGlobalError(null);

        // Montagem do Payload (Mapeia o form plano para o DTO complexo com array de endereços)
        const addressesToSend = data.address?.street?.trim() ? [{
            id: data.address.id || undefined,
            street: data.address.street,
            number: data.address.number || 'S/N',
            district: data.address.district || 'Centro',
            city: data.address.city || 'Indefinida',
            state: data.address.state || 'UF',
            zipCode: data.address.zipCode || '00000000',
            type: AddressType.MAIN
        }] : undefined;

        const payload = {
            name: data.name,
            document: data.document?.trim() || undefined,
            email: data.email?.trim() || undefined,
            phone: data.phone?.trim() || undefined,
            userNotes: data.userNotes?.trim() || undefined,
            isActive: data.isActive,
            addresses: addressesToSend
        };

        try {
            let result: Client;
            if (isEditing && client) {
                result = await updateClient(client.id, payload);
            } else {
                result = await createClient(payload);
            }
            onSuccess(result);
            
        } catch (err: any) {
            console.error("❌ [ClientForm] Erro ao salvar:", err);
            
            // 🎯 AQUI RESOLVEMOS A BOMBINHA (Erro 409 - Conflito de Documento/Email)
            if (err.response?.status === 409) {
                const apiMsg = err.response?.data?.message || '';
                
                if (apiMsg.toLowerCase().includes('documento') || apiMsg.toLowerCase().includes('cpf')) {
                    setError('document', { type: 'manual', message: 'Este documento já está cadastrado no sistema.' });
                } else if (apiMsg.toLowerCase().includes('email')) {
                    setError('email', { type: 'manual', message: 'Este e-mail já pertence a outro cliente.' });
                } else {
                    setGlobalError(apiMsg || 'Conflito de dados (registro duplicado).');
                }
            } else {
                setGlobalError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ocorreu um erro interno ao salvar o cliente.');
            }
        }
    };

    // =========================================================================
    // 🎨 RENDERIZAÇÃO UX/UI
    // =========================================================================
    return (
        <form id="client-edit-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmitForm)} className="space-y-5 animate-fade-in">
            
            {globalError && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-red-900/30 border border-red-800 text-red-300 rounded-lg text-sm flex items-center shadow-inner">
                    <FaExclamationTriangle className="mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span>{globalError}</span>
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* --- NOME --- */}
                <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-accent-primary uppercase mb-1 tracking-wider">
                        Nome Completo *
                    </label>
                    <input 
                        type="text" 
                        {...register('name')}
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        className={`w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-900 border rounded-lg text-white text-sm focus:outline-none transition placeholder-gray-600 ${errors.name ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500' : 'border-gray-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-secondary focus:border-accent-secondary'}`}
                        placeholder="Ex: João Silva ou Empresa Ltda"
                    />
                    {errors.name && <p className="text-[10px] text-red-400 mt-1">{errors.name.message as string}</p>}
                </div>

                {/* --- CONTATO (Grid) --- */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase mb-1 tracking-wider">
                            E-mail
                        </label>
                        <input 
                            type="email" 
                            {...register('email')}
                            disabled={isLoading}
                            className={`w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-900 border rounded-lg text-white text-sm focus:outline-none transition ${errors.email ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500' : 'border-gray-600 focus:border-gray-400'}`}
                            placeholder="contato@email.com"
                        />
                        {errors.email && <p className="text-[10px] text-red-400 mt-1">{errors.email.message as string}</p>}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase mb-1 tracking-wider">
                            Telefone
                        </label>
                        <input 
                            type="text" 
                            {...register('phone')}
                            disabled={isLoading}
                            placeholder="(00) 00000-0000"
                            className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-gray-400 transition" 
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* --- ENDEREÇO PRINCIPAL --- */}
            <div className="bg-gray-800/40 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-700/50">
                <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-300 uppercase mb-3 flex items-center tracking-wider">
                    <FaMapMarkerAlt className="mr-1.5 text-accent-secondary" /> Endereço Principal
                </label>
                
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                    <div className="col-span-3">
                        <input type="text" {...register('address.street')} placeholder="Rua / Logradouro" disabled={isLoading}
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-1">
                        <input type="text" {...register('address.number')} placeholder="Nº" disabled={isLoading}
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="col-span-2">
                        <input type="text" {...register('address.district')} placeholder="Bairro" disabled={isLoading}
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2">
                        <input type="text" {...register('address.city')} placeholder="Cidade" disabled={isLoading}
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="col-span-1">
                        <input type="text" {...register('address.state')} placeholder="UF" maxLength={2} disabled={isLoading}
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-2 text-xs text-white uppercase focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-3">
                        <input type="text" {...register('address.zipCode')} placeholder="CEP" disabled={isLoading}
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* --- DOCUMENTO (CPF/CNPJ) --- */}
            <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1 tracking-wider">
                    CPF / CNPJ
                </label>
                <input 
                    type="text" 
                    {...register('document')}
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className={`w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-900 border rounded-lg text-white text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none transition placeholder-gray-600 ${errors.document ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500' : 'border-gray-600 focus:border-gray-400'}`}
                    placeholder="000.000.000-00"
                />
                {errors.document && <p className="text-[10px] text-red-400 mt-1 font-bold animate-pulse">{errors.document.message as string}</p>}
            </div>

            {/* --- ANOTAÇÕES HUMANAS --- */}
            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-700/50">
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase mb-2 tracking-wider flex items-center">
                    <FaStickyNote className="mr-1.5 text-yellow-500/70" /> Notas Privadas (Não lidas pela IA)
                </label>
                <textarea
                    {...register('userNotes')}
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    rows={4}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-800/50 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-yellow-500/50 transition placeholder-gray-600 resize-y"
                    placeholder="Digite observações internas sobre este cliente..."
                />
            </div>

            {/* BOTÃO INTERNO (Usado apenas se o modal pai não usar form="client-edit-form") */}
            {showSubmitButton && (
                <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="w-full flex justify-center items-center py-3 px-4 border border-transparent rounded-lg shadow-lg text-sm font-bold text-white bg-accent-secondary hover:bg-violet-600 transition disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transform active:scale-95 mt-4"
                >
                    {isLoading ? (
                        <span className="animate-pulse">{isEditing ? 'Salvando...' : 'Cadastrando...'}</span>
                    ) : (
                        <>
                            <FaSave className="mr-2" />
                            {isEditing ? 'Salvar Alterações' : 'Cadastrar Cliente'}
                        </>
                    )}
                </button>
            )}
        </form>
    );
};


// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/communication/WhatsAppWidget.tsx =====

// src/modules/crm/components/communication/WhatsAppWidget.tsx

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { FaWhatsapp, FaQrcode, FaUnlink, FaCheckCircle, FaSync, FaExclamationTriangle } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useMessaging } from '@/core/hooks/useMessaging';

/**
 * @component WhatsAppWidget
 * @description Gerencia a conexão com a instância do WhatsApp (Evolution API).
 * Exibe QR Code para pareamento ou Status de Conectado.
 */
export const WhatsAppWidget: React.FC = () => {
    
    const { 
        connectionStatus, 
        isLoading, 
        error, 
        checkStatus, 
        connectSession, 
        disconnectSession 
    } = useMessaging();

    // Verifica o status ao montar o componente
    useEffect(() => {
        checkStatus();
    }, [checkStatus]);

    // --- HANDLERS ---
    
    const handleConnect = () => {
        connectSession();
    };

    const handleDisconnect = () => {
        if (confirm("Tem certeza que deseja desconectar o WhatsApp deste Tenant?")) {
            disconnectSession();
        }
    };

    // --- RENDERIZAÇÃO DE ESTADOS ---

    // 1. Loading
    if (isLoading) {
        return (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-gray-400 space-y-3 p-6">
                <FaSync className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-accent-primary" />
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Comunicando com o Servidor...</span>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // 2. Erro
    if (error) {
        return (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-red-400 space-y-3 p-6 text-center">
                <FaExclamationTriangle className="w-8 h-8" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold">{error}</span>
                <button 
                    onClick={() => checkStatus()} 
                    className="text-xs underline hover:text-white"
                >
                    Tentar Novamente
                </button>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // 3. Conectado (Sucesso)
    if (connectionStatus?.isConnected) {
        return (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full space-y-4 p-6 bg-green-900/10 rounded-lg border border-green-900/30">
                <div className="relative">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-green-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-green-900/50">
                        <FaWhatsapp className="w-8 h-8 text-white" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-5 h-5 bg-green-400 border-2 border-base-metallic rounded-full"></div>
                </div>
                
                <div className="text-center">
                    <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-lg">WhatsApp Conectado</h3>
                    <p className="text-green-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide mt-1">
                        Instância: {connectionStatus.instanceName}
                    </p>
                </div>

                <button 
                    onClick={handleDisconnect}
                    className="flex items-center px-4 py-2 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-red-900/50 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-400 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition border border-gray-700 hover:border-red-800"
                >
                    <FaUnlink className="mr-2" /> Desconectar
                </button>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // 4. Desconectado (Com ou Sem QR Code)
    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full space-y-6 p-6">
            
            {/* Se tiver QR Code, mostra ele. Senão, mostra o ícone genérico */}
            {connectionStatus?.qrCode ? (
                <div className="bg-white p-2 rounded-lg shadow-xl animate-fade-in">
                    {/* Renderiza a string Base64 como imagem */}
                    <img 
                        src={connectionStatus.qrCode} 
                        alt="QR Code WhatsApp" 
                        className="w-48 h-48 object-contain" 
                    />
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-gray-800 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-dashed border-gray-600 text-gray-500">
                    <FaQrcode className="w-8 h-8" />
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="text-center max-w-xs">
                <h3 className="text-white font-bold mb-1">
                    {connectionStatus?.qrCode ? 'Escaneie o QR Code' : 'WhatsApp Desconectado'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs">
                    {connectionStatus?.qrCode 
                        ? 'Abra o WhatsApp no seu celular e escaneie o código acima para conectar.' 
                        : 'Integre seu número para enviar mensagens diretamente pelo CRM.'}
                </p>
            </div>

            {!connectionStatus?.qrCode && (
                <button 
                    onClick={handleConnect}
                    className="flex items-center px-6 py-2.5 bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold shadow-lg shadow-green-900/20 transition transform active:scale-95 text-sm"
                >
                    <FaWhatsapp className="mr-2 w-5 h-5" />
                    Gerar QR Code
                </button>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};


// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deal-editor/DealEditor.tsx =====

// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deal-editor/DealEditor.tsx =====

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FaTimes, FaSave, FaUser, FaCalendar, FaBoxOpen, FaTrash, FaPlus, FaStream } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { CRMDeal, DealStatus, CRMDealItem } from '@/modules/crm/types';
import { IPipelineStage } from '../../types/pipeline.types';
import { useClients } from '@/core/client/hooks/useClients';
import { useDeals } from '../../hooks/useDeals';

interface DealEditorProps {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onSuccess: () => void;
    stages: IPipelineStage[];
    pipelineId: string;
    dealToEdit?: CRMDeal; 
    defaultStageId?: string;
}

export const DealEditor: React.FC<DealEditorProps> = ({ 
    isOpen, 
    onClose, 
    onSuccess,
    stages,
    pipelineId,
    dealToEdit,
    defaultStageId
}) => {
    
    // Hooks de Dados
    const { clients } = useClients(); 
    const { createDeal, updateDeal } = useDeals();

    // ============================================================================
    // 1. BLINDAGEM (DEFENSIVE PROGRAMMING)
    // ============================================================================
    if (isOpen && (!stages || stages.length === 0)) {
        return null;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 2. ESTADOS DO FORMULÁRIO (Dinâmicos)
    // ============================================================================
    const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
    const [clientId, setClientId] = useState('');
    const [closingDate, setClosingDate] = useState('');
    const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
    const [currentStageId, setCurrentStageId] = useState<string>('');
    const [items, setItems] = useState<CRMDealItem[]>([]);
    const [totalAmount, setTotalAmount] = useState(0);
    const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

    // ============================================================================
    // 3. EFEITOS (CARREGAMENTO)
    // ============================================================================
    useEffect(() => {
        if (isOpen) {
            if (dealToEdit) {
                // --- MODO EDIÇÃO ---
                setTitle(dealToEdit.title);
                setClientId(dealToEdit.clientId);
                setClosingDate(dealToEdit.expectedCloseDate ? new Date(dealToEdit.expectedCloseDate).toISOString().split('T')[0] : '');
                
                const activeStage = dealToEdit.currentStageId || stages.find(s => s.code === dealToEdit.status)?.id || stages[0].id;
                setCurrentStageId(activeStage);
                
                if (dealToEdit.items) {
                    setItems(dealToEdit.items.map(i => ({ ...i})));
                }
            } else {
                // --- MODO CRIAÇÃO ---
                resetForm();
                setCurrentStageId(defaultStageId || stages[0]?.id || '');
            }
        }
    }, [isOpen, dealToEdit, defaultStageId, stages]);

    // Calcula total
    useEffect(() => {
        const total = items.reduce((acc, item) => acc + (item.quantity * item.unitPrice), 0);
        setTotalAmount(total);
    }, [items]);

    const resetForm = () => {
        setTitle('');
        setClientId('');
        setClosingDate('');
        setDescription('');
        setItems([]);
        setTotalAmount(0);
    };

    // ============================================================================
    // 4. HANDLERS
    // ============================================================================
    const handleAddItem = () => {
        setItems([...items, { id: Date.now().toString(), description: '', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 0, type: 'SERVICE' } as CRMDealItem]);
    };

    const handleUpdateItem = (id: string, field: keyof CRMDealItem, value: any) => {
        setItems(items.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, [field]: value } : item));
    };

    const handleRemoveItem = (id: string) => {
        setItems(items.filter(item => item.id !== id));
    };

    const handleSave = async () => {
        if (!title || !clientId || !currentStageId) {
            alert("Preencha os campos obrigatórios (Título, Cliente e Fase).");
            return;
        }

        setIsSaving(true);
        try {
            const selectedStage = stages.find(s => s.id === currentStageId);
            const derivedStatus = (selectedStage?.code as DealStatus) || DealStatus.NEW;

            const payload = {
                title,
                clientId,
                pipelineId,
                currentStageId,
                status: derivedStatus,
                value: totalAmount,
                expectedCloseDate: closingDate ? new Date(closingDate).toISOString() : undefined,
                items: items.map(i => ({
                    description: i.description,
                    quantity: i.quantity,
                    unitPrice: i.unitPrice,
                    type: 'SERVICE'
                }))
            };

            if (dealToEdit) {
                await updateDeal(dealToEdit.id, payload);
            } else {
                await createDeal(payload);
            }
            
            onSuccess();
            onClose();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Erro ao salvar:", error);
            alert("Erro ao salvar negócio.");
        } finally {
            setIsSaving(false);
        }
    };

    // ============================================================================
    // 5. RENDERIZAÇÃO (VISUAL SÓLIDO)
    // ============================================================================
    return (
        <div 
            className={`
                fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center
                transition-all duration-300
                ${isOpen ? 'opacity-100 visible' : 'opacity-0 invisible pointer-events-none'}
            `}
        >
            {/* Backdrop com Blur suave e fundo escuro */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}></div>

            {/* Modal Principal (Superfície Sólida) */}
            <div 
                className={`
                    relative w-full max-w-5xl h-[90vh] 
                    bg-gray-900 rounded-2xl border border-gray-800 shadow-2xl 
                    flex flex-col overflow-hidden
                    transform transition-all duration-300
                    ${isOpen ? 'scale-100 translate-y-0' : 'scale-95 translate-y-4'}
                `}
            >
                
                {/* --- HEADER --- */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-6 border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-900 flex-shrink-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="p-3 bg-accent-primary/10 rounded-xl border border-accent-primary/20 text-accent-primary">
                            <FaBoxOpen size={24} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-100">
                                {dealToEdit ? 'Editar Oportunidade' : 'Nova Oportunidade'}
                            </h2>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                                <FaStream size={10} /> 
                                {stages.find(s => s.id === currentStageId)?.name || 'Funil de Vendas'}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg transition-colors">
                        <FaTimes size={20} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* --- BODY SCROLLÁVEL --- */}
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-8 space-y-8 custom-scrollbar bg-gray-900">
                    
                    {/* Bloco 1: Dados Principais */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
                        
                        {/* Cliente */}
                        <div className="md:col-span-6 space-y-2">
                            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider ml-1">Cliente *</label>
                            <div className="relative group">
                                <FaUser className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-gray-500 group-hover:text-accent-primary transition-colors" />
                                <select 
                                    value={clientId} 
                                    onChange={(e) => setClientId(e.target.value)}
                                    className="w-full bg-gray-800 pl-11 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 focus:border-accent-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-primary focus:outline-none appearance-none text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                    <option value="">Selecione o cliente...</option>
                                    {clients.map(c => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>)}
                                </select>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Título */}
                        <div className="md:col-span-6 space-y-2">
                            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider ml-1">Título da Oportunidade *</label>
                            <input 
                                type="text" 
                                value={title} 
                                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Ex: Contrato de Consultoria"
                                className="w-full bg-gray-800 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 focus:border-accent-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-primary focus:outline-none text-white placeholder-gray-600 transition-all"
                            />
                        </div>

                        {/* Fase do Funil */}
                        <div className="md:col-span-4 space-y-2">
                            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider ml-1">Etapa Atual</label>
                            <div className="relative group">
                                <div 
                                    className="absolute left-4 top-4 w-3 h-3 rounded-full shadow-sm"
                                    style={{ backgroundColor: stages.find(s => s.id === currentStageId)?.color || '#555' }}
                                ></div>
                                <select 
                                    value={currentStageId} 
                                    onChange={(e) => setCurrentStageId(e.target.value)}
                                    className="w-full bg-gray-800 pl-11 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 focus:border-accent-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-primary focus:outline-none appearance-none text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                    {stages.map(stage => (
                                        <option key={stage.id} value={stage.id}>
                                            {stage.name}
                                        </option>
                                    ))}
                                </select>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Data */}
                        <div className="md:col-span-4 space-y-2">
                            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider ml-1">Previsão Fechamento</label>
                            <div className="relative group">
                                <FaCalendar className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-gray-500 group-hover:text-accent-primary transition-colors" />
                                <input 
                                    type="date" 
                                    value={closingDate} 
                                    onChange={(e) => setClosingDate(e.target.value)}
                                    className="w-full bg-gray-800 pl-11 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 focus:border-accent-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-primary focus:outline-none text-white transition-all cursor-pointer [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:filter [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:invert"
                                />
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Totalizador */}
                        <div className="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col justify-end pb-2 text-right">
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Valor Total (Automático)</span>
                            <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-500 tracking-tight">
                                {new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(totalAmount)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Bloco 2: Itens (Tabela) */}
                    <div className="pt-8 border-t border-gray-800">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-300 uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
                                <FaBoxOpen className="text-gray-500" /> Produtos e Serviços
                            </h3>
                        </div>

                        <div className="border border-gray-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-gray-900">
                            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                                <thead className="bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 font-medium text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th className="p-4 w-1/2">Descrição</th>
                                        <th className="p-4 w-24 text-center">Qtd</th>
                                        <th className="p-4 w-32 text-right">Valor Unit.</th>
                                        <th className="p-4 w-32 text-right">Subtotal</th>
                                        <th className="p-4 w-12 text-center">Ação</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                                    {items.map(item => (
                                        <tr key={item.id} className="group hover:bg-gray-800/30 transition-colors">
                                            <td className="p-2 pl-4">
                                                <input 
                                                    type="text" 
                                                    value={item.description} 
                                                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateItem(item.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                                                    placeholder="Digite o nome do produto/serviço..."
                                                    className="w-full bg-transparent text-gray-200 placeholder-gray-600 focus:outline-none focus:bg-gray-800/80 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-all border border-transparent focus:border-gray-700"
                                                />
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="p-2">
                                                <input 
                                                    type="number" min="1" 
                                                    value={item.quantity} 
                                                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateItem(item.id, 'quantity', Number(e.target.value))}
                                                    className="w-full bg-transparent text-center text-gray-200 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 border border-transparent focus:bg-gray-800/80 focus:border-gray-700 focus:outline-none transition-all"
                                                />
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="p-2">
                                                <input 
                                                    type="number" min="0" step="0.01" 
                                                    value={item.unitPrice} 
                                                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateItem(item.id, 'unitPrice', Number(e.target.value))}
                                                    className="w-full bg-transparent text-right text-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-transparent focus:bg-gray-800/80 focus:border-gray-700 focus:outline-none transition-all"
                                                />
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="p-4 text-right font-medium text-gray-300">
                                                R$ {(item.quantity * item.unitPrice).toFixed(2)}
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="p-2 text-center">
                                                <button 
                                                    onClick={() => handleRemoveItem(item.id)} 
                                                    className="p-2 text-gray-600 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-400/10 rounded-lg transition-colors opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
                                                    title="Remover item"
                                                >
                                                    <FaTrash size={14} />
                                                </button>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    ))}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                            
                            {/* Botão Adicionar (Linha Pontilhada) */}
                            <button 
                                onClick={handleAddItem}
                                className="w-full p-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-accent-primary bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800/50 border-t border-dashed border-gray-700 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                            >
                                <FaPlus size={12} />
                                Adicionar nova linha
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                </div>

                {/* --- FOOTER --- */}
                <div className="p-6 border-t border-gray-800 bg-gray-900 flex justify-end gap-4 flex-shrink-0">
                    <button 
                        onClick={onClose} 
                        className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"
                    >
                        Cancelar
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={handleSave} 
                        disabled={isSaving}
                        className="px-8 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-white bg-accent-primary hover:bg-orange-600 shadow-lg shadow-orange-900/20 flex items-center gap-2 transition transform active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >
                        {isSaving ? 'Salvando...' : <><FaSave /> Salvar Negócio</>}
                    </button>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    );
};


// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deal-editor/DealHeaderForm.tsx =====




// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deal-editor/DealItemsTable.tsx =====




// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deal-editor/index.ts =====




// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deals/DealForm.tsx =====

// src/modules/crm/components/deals/DealForm.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FaSave, FaPlus, FaTrash, FaBox, FaWrench, FaExclamationTriangle, FaLink } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useClients } from '@/core/client/hooks/useClients';
import { useDeals } from '@/modules/crm/hooks/useDeals'; 
import { DealStatus, DealItemType, CRMDeal } from '@/modules/crm/types'; 
import { Product } from '@/modules/products/types'; 
import { ProductSelector } from '@/modules/products/components/ProductSelector'; 

interface DealFormProps {
    deal?: CRMDeal;
    initialStatus?: DealStatus;
    onSuccess: () => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
    
    // --- NOVO: Recebe o ID do funil vindo do Modal -> Kanban -> Container ---
    pipelineId?: string;
}

interface LocalItem {
    id: string;
    productId?: string;
    description: string;
    quantity: number;
    unitPrice: number;
    type: DealItemType;
}

export const DealForm: React.FC<DealFormProps> = ({ 
    deal, 
    initialStatus, 
    onSuccess, 
    onCancel,
    pipelineId // <--- Destrutarando a nova prop
}) => {
    
    const { clients } = useClients();
    const { createDeal, updateDeal, isLoading } = useDeals();

    const isEditing = !!deal;

    // Estados
    const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
    const [clientId, setClientId] = useState('');
    const [status, setStatus] = useState<DealStatus>(initialStatus || DealStatus.NEW);
    const [probability, setProbability] = useState(50);
    const [items, setItems] = useState<LocalItem[]>([]);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const [newItem, setNewItem] = useState<Partial<LocalItem>>({
        description: '',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 0,
        type: DealItemType.SERVICE,
        productId: undefined
    });

    useEffect(() => {
        if (deal) {
            setTitle(deal.title);
            setClientId(deal.clientId);
            setStatus(deal.status);
            setProbability(deal.probability);
            
            if (deal.items && deal.items.length > 0) {
                setItems(deal.items.map(i => ({
                    id: i.id,
                    productId: i.productId || undefined,
                    description: i.description,
                    quantity: Number(i.quantity),
                    unitPrice: Number(i.unitPrice),
                    type: i.type
                })));
            } else {
                setItems([]);
            }
        } else {
            setStatus(initialStatus || DealStatus.NEW);
        }
    }, [deal, initialStatus]);

    const totalValue = items.reduce((acc, item) => acc + (item.quantity * item.unitPrice), 0);

    const handleProductSelect = (product: Product) => {
        setNewItem({
            ...newItem,
            productId: product.id,
            description: product.title,
            unitPrice: product.promotionalPrice || product.price,
            type: product.type === 'SERVICE' ? DealItemType.SERVICE : DealItemType.PRODUCT
        });
    };

    const handleDescriptionChange = (text: string) => {
        setNewItem({
            ...newItem,
            productId: undefined,
            description: text
        });
    };

    const handleAddItem = () => {
        if (!newItem.description || newItem.unitPrice === undefined) return;
        setItems(prev => [...prev, {
            id: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
            productId: newItem.productId,
            description: newItem.description!,
            quantity: Number(newItem.quantity),
            unitPrice: Number(newItem.unitPrice),
            type: newItem.type || DealItemType.SERVICE
        }]);
        setNewItem({ description: '', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 0, type: DealItemType.SERVICE, productId: undefined });
    };

    const handleRemoveItem = (id: string) => {
        setItems(prev => prev.filter(i => i.id !== id));
    };

    const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setError(null);

        if (!clientId) {
            setError("Selecione um cliente para prosseguir.");
            return;
        }

        const payload = {
            title,
            clientId,
            status,
            probability,
            items: items.map(i => ({
                productId: i.productId,
                description: i.description,
                quantity: i.quantity,
                unitPrice: i.unitPrice,
                type: i.type
            })),
            // --- CONEXÃO FINAL: Enviamos o pipelineId apenas na criação ---
            pipelineId: isEditing ? undefined : pipelineId 
        };

        try {
            if (isEditing && deal) {
                await updateDeal(deal.id, payload);
            } else {
                await createDeal(payload);
            }
            onSuccess();
        } catch (err: any) {
            console.error(err);
            setError("Erro ao salvar oportunidade. Verifique os dados.");
        }
    };

    return (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col h-full">
            
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-1 pr-2 space-y-6">
                
                {error && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-red-900/30 border border-red-800 text-red-300 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center">
                        <FaExclamationTriangle className="mr-2" /> {error}
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                     <div className="col-span-2">
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-accent-primary uppercase mb-1">Título da Oportunidade *</label>
                        <input 
                            type="text" value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} required
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none"
                            placeholder="Ex: Projeto Site Institucional"
                        />
                    </div>
                     <div className="col-span-2 md:col-span-1">
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase mb-1">Cliente *</label>
                        <select 
                            value={clientId} onChange={e => setClientId(e.target.value)} required disabled={isEditing} 
                            className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                            <option value="">Selecione...</option>
                            {clients.map(client => (
                                <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>{client.name}</option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-1">
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase mb-1">Fase do Funil</label>
                        <select value={status} onChange={e => setStatus(e.target.value as DealStatus)} className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none">
                            {Object.values(DealStatus).map(s => (<option key={s} value={s}>{s.replace('_', ' ')}</option>))}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-1">
                         <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase mb-1">Probabilidade (%)</label>
                         <input type="number" min="0" max="100" value={probability} onChange={e => setProbability(Number(e.target.value))} className="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:border-accent-secondary focus:outline-none" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-1 flex flex-col justify-end pb-2">
                        <div className="text-right">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 uppercase font-bold">Valor Total Estimado</span>
                            <div className="text-xl font-bold text-green-400">
                                {new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(totalValue)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* 2. GRID DE ITENS */}
                <div className="border-t border-gray-700 pt-4">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white mb-3 flex items-center">
                        <span className="bg-accent-secondary/20 text-accent-secondary p-1 rounded mr-2"><FaBox size={10}/></span> 
                        Itens do Negócio (Produtos/Serviços)
                    </h4>

                    <div className="bg-gray-800/50 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 overflow-visible">
                        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                            <thead className="bg-gray-900 text-gray-400 uppercase font-bold">
                                <tr>
                                    <th className="px-3 py-2">Tipo</th>
                                    <th className="px-3 py-2">Descrição / Produto</th>
                                    <th className="px-3 py-2 w-20">Qtd</th>
                                    <th className="px-3 py-2 w-28">Valor Unit.</th>
                                    <th className="px-3 py-2 w-10"></th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-700">
                                {items.map(item => (
                                    <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-gray-700/50 transition">
                                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                                            {item.type === DealItemType.SERVICE ? <FaWrench className="text-blue-400" /> : <FaBox className="text-orange-400" />}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-white flex items-center">
                                            {item.productId && <FaLink className="mr-2 text-accent-primary" title="Vinculado ao Catálogo" />}
                                            {item.description}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-300">{item.quantity}</td>
                                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-300">
                                            {new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(item.unitPrice)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-center">
                                            <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRemoveItem(item.id)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-400">
                                                <FaTrash />
                                            </button>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                ))}

                                {/* Linha de Input */}
                                <tr className="bg-gray-800/80">
                                    <td className="px-2 py-2 align-top">
                                        <select 
                                            value={newItem.type} 
                                            onChange={e => setNewItem({...newItem, type: e.target.value as DealItemType})}
                                            className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-1 py-1.5 text-white text-[10px] w-full focus:outline-none"
                                        >
                                            <option value={DealItemType.SERVICE}>Serv.</option>
                                            <option value={DealItemType.PRODUCT}>Prod.</option>
                                        </select>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-2 py-2 align-top relative z-50">
                                        <ProductSelector 
                                            value={newItem.description || ''}
                                            onChange={handleDescriptionChange}
                                            onSelect={handleProductSelect}
                                            placeholder="Digite ou clique na lupa..."
                                        />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-2 py-2 align-top">
                                        <input 
                                            type="number" min="1"
                                            value={newItem.quantity}
                                            onChange={e => setNewItem({...newItem, quantity: Number(e.target.value)})}
                                            className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-white w-full focus:border-accent-primary focus:outline-none"
                                        />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-2 py-2 align-top">
                                        <input 
                                            type="number" min="0" step="0.01"
                                            value={newItem.unitPrice}
                                            onChange={e => setNewItem({...newItem, unitPrice: Number(e.target.value)})}
                                            className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-white w-full focus:border-accent-primary focus:outline-none"
                                        />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center align-top">
                                        <button type="button" onClick={handleAddItem} className="bg-accent-primary hover:bg-orange-600 text-base-dark p-1.5 rounded shadow transition">
                                            <FaPlus size={10} />
                                        </button>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-gray-700 mt-4">
                <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-700 transition">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" disabled={isLoading} className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-base-dark bg-accent-secondary hover:bg-violet-500 shadow-lg transition transform active:scale-95 flex items-center">
                    {isLoading ? 'Salvando...' : <><FaSave className="mr-2" /> {isEditing ? 'Salvar Alterações' : 'Criar Oportunidade'}</>}
                </button>
            </div>
        </form>
    );
};


// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/deals/DealModal.tsx =====

// src/modules/crm/components/deals/DealModal.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { FaTimes, FaHandshake } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { DealForm } from './DealForm';
import { DealStatus, CRMDeal } from '@/modules/crm/types';

interface DealModalProps {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onSuccess: () => void;
    defaultStatus?: DealStatus;
    
    // --- PROPS PARA EDIÇÃO ---
    dealToEdit?: CRMDeal; // Ajustei o nome para bater com o que vimos no CRMKanbanView (lá estava dealToEdit)
    
    // --- NOVO PROP: Contexto do Funil ---
    pipelineId?: string;
}

export const DealModal: React.FC<DealModalProps> = ({ 
    isOpen, 
    onClose, 
    onSuccess,
    defaultStatus,
    dealToEdit, // Usando o nome mais comum vindo do pai
    pipelineId  // <--- Recebendo o ID
}) => {
    
    if (!isOpen) return null;

    const isEditing = !!dealToEdit;

    return (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-base-dark/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center transition-all animate-fade-in p-4">
            
            <div 
                className="bg-base-metallic w-full max-w-2xl rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-600 flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] transform scale-100 transition-all"
                onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-5 border-b border-gray-700 bg-gray-800/50 rounded-t-xl">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                        <div className="p-2 bg-accent-secondary/20 rounded-lg text-accent-secondary">
                            <FaHandshake size={20} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
                                {isEditing ? 'Editar Oportunidade' : 'Nova Oportunidade'}
                            </h2>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Defina os detalhes e itens do negócio.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button 
                        onClick={onClose}
                        className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-700 p-2 rounded-full transition"
                    >
                        <FaTimes />
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* Corpo */}
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden p-6">
                    <DealForm 
                        deal={dealToEdit} // Passa o objeto de edição
                        initialStatus={defaultStatus}
                        
                        // --- AQUI ESTÁ A CONEXÃO ---
                        // Passamos o ID do funil para o formulário saber onde salvar
                        pipelineId={pipelineId}
                        
                        onSuccess={() => { onSuccess(); onClose(); }}
                        onCancel={onClose}
                    />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};


// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/kanban/DealCard.tsx =====

// src/modules/crm/components/kanban/DealCard.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { Draggable } from '@hello-pangea/dnd';
import { CRMDeal } from '@/modules/crm/types';
import { FaBuilding } from 'react-icons/fa';

interface DealCardProps {
    deal: CRMDeal;
    index: number;
    onEdit: (deal: CRMDeal) => void; // <--- NOVO
}

export const DealCard: React.FC<DealCardProps> = ({ deal, index, onEdit }) => {
    
    const formattedValue = new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'BRL'
    }).format(Number(deal.value));

    return (
        <Draggable draggableId={deal.id} index={index}>
            {(provided, snapshot) => (
                <div
                    ref={provided.innerRef}
                    {...provided.draggableProps}
                    {...provided.dragHandleProps}
                    // --- AÇÃO DE CLIQUE DUPLO PARA EDITAR ---
                    onDoubleClick={() => onEdit(deal)} 
                    className={`
                        bg-gray-800 p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 shadow-sm mb-3
                        hover:border-accent-secondary/50 transition-all group cursor-pointer
                        ${snapshot.isDragging ? 'shadow-2xl ring-2 ring-accent-primary rotate-2 z-50' : ''}
                    `}
                    style={{
                        ...provided.draggableProps.style,
                    }}
                    title="Clique duas vezes para editar"
                >
                    {/* Título e Probabilidade */}
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white line-clamp-2 leading-tight">
                            {deal.title}
                        </h4>
                        {deal.probability > 0 && (
                            <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded 
                                ${deal.probability >= 70 ? 'bg-green-900/50 text-green-400' : 'bg-yellow-900/50 text-yellow-400'}
                            `}>
                                {deal.probability}%
                            </span>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Cliente */}
                    <div className="flex items-center text-xs text-gray-400 mb-3">
                        <FaBuilding className="mr-1.5 w-3 h-3 opacity-50" />
                        <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">
                            {deal.client?.name || 'Cliente Desconhecido'}
                        </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Footer */}
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-t border-gray-700/50 pt-2">
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 flex items-center">
                            <span className="text-green-500 mr-1">$</span> {formattedValue}
                        </div>
                        
                        <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-700 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-white border border-gray-600">
                            <span className="font-bold">V</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </Draggable>
    );
};

// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/kanban/EmptyPipelineState.tsx =====

import React from 'react';
import { FaMagic, FaStream, FaArrowRight } from 'react-icons/fa';

interface EmptyPipelineStateProps {
    /**
     * Ação para acionar o Agente de IA com o prompt de criação padrão.
     */
    onGenerateWithAI: () => void;

    /**
     * Ação para abrir o Drawer de configuração manual.
     */
    onManualConfig: () => void;
}

/**
 * @component EmptyPipelineState
 * @description Estado zero do Kanban. Exibido quando não há funis ou estágios configurados.
 * Oferece dois caminhos: Geração Automática (IA) ou Configuração Manual.
 */
export const EmptyPipelineState: React.FC<EmptyPipelineStateProps> = ({ 
    onGenerateWithAI, 
    onManualConfig 
}) => {
    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full p-8 animate-fade-in">
            
            {/* Ícone Central Destacado */}
            <div className="relative mb-8 group cursor-default">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-accent-primary/20 blur-xl rounded-full opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-70 transition-opacity duration-500"></div>
                <div className="relative bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-800 to-base-dark p-6 rounded-2xl border border-gray-700 shadow-2xl">
                    <FaStream className="w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 group-hover:text-accent-secondary transition-colors duration-300" />
                    
                    {/* Badge flutuante indicando IA */}
                    <div className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-accent-primary text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-orange-400/50 animate-bounce-slow">
                        <FaMagic size={12} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Texto de Boas-vindas */}
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-3 text-center tracking-tight">
                Vamos organizar suas vendas?
            </h2>
            <p className="text-gray-400 text-center max-w-md mb-10 leading-relaxed text-sm">
                Você ainda não tem um funil configurado. O CRM precisa de etapas (ex: Novo, Negociação) para organizar seus negócios.
            </p>

            {/* Área de Ações */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 w-full max-w-md">
                
                {/* AÇÃO PRINCIPAL: IA MAGIC */}
                <button 
                    onClick={onGenerateWithAI}
                    className="flex-1 group relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-accent-primary hover:bg-orange-600 transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg shadow-orange-900/20 p-1"
                >
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/10 translate-y-full group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-transform duration-300"></div>
                    <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 h-full">
                        <FaMagic className="text-white animate-pulse" />
                        <div className="text-left">
                            <span className="block text-xs font-bold text-orange-200 uppercase tracking-wider">Recomendado</span>
                            <span className="block text-sm font-bold text-white">Criar Funil com IA</span>
                        </div>
                        <FaArrowRight className="ml-auto text-white/50 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                    </div>
                </button>

                {/* AÇÃO SECUNDÁRIA: MANUAL */}
                <button 
                    onClick={onManualConfig}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 hover:border-gray-500 bg-gray-800/50 hover:bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 hover:text-white transition-all font-medium text-sm group"
                >
                    <FaStream className="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-300 transition-colors" />
                    Configurar Manualmente
                </button>
            </div>

            {/* Dica de Rodapé */}
            <div className="mt-8 text-xs text-gray-600 text-center">
                <p>A Inteligência Artificial pode criar um fluxo padrão de vendas em segundos.</p>
            </div>

        </div>
    );
};


// ===== FILE: src/modules/crm/components/kanban/KanbanBoard.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { DragDropContext, DropResult, Droppable } from '@hello-pangea/dnd';
import { CRMDeal, DealStatus } from '@/modules/crm/types';
import { IPipelineStage } from '@/modules/crm/types/pipeline.types';
import { KanbanColumn } from './KanbanColumn';

interface KanbanBoardProps {
    deals: CRMDeal[];
    stages: IPipelineStage[]; // <--- NOVO: Recebe as fases dinâmicas
    onDealMove: (dealId: string, newStageId: string, newStatus?: DealStatus) => void;
    onAddDeal: (status: DealStatus) => void;
    onEditDeal: (deal: CRMDeal) => void;
}

export const KanbanBoard: React.FC<KanbanBoardProps> = ({ 
    deals, 
    stages, 
    onDealMove, 
    onAddDeal, 
    onEditDeal 
}) => {
    const [isBrowser, setIsBrowser] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        setIsBrowser(true);
    }, []);

    const handleDragEnd = (result: DropResult) => {
        const { destination, source, draggableId } = result;

        if (!destination) return;
        if (destination.droppableId === source.droppableId && destination.index === source.index) return;

        // O droppableId agora é o ID do Stage (UUID), não mais o Status fixo
        const newStageId = destination.droppableId;
        
        // Encontramos o stage para saber qual o 'code' (status) correspondente
        const targetStage = stages.find(s => s.id === newStageId);
        const newStatus = targetStage?.code as DealStatus || DealStatus.NEW;

        onDealMove(draggableId, newStageId, newStatus);
    };

    if (!isBrowser) return <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-gray-500">Carregando Kanban...</div>;

    // Se não vier stages (ex: carregando ou erro), mostramos estado vazio
    if (!stages || stages.length === 0) {
        return <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-gray-500">Selecione um funil para visualizar.</div>;
    }

    return (
        <DragDropContext onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}>
            <div className="flex h-full space-x-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4 px-2">
                {/* Agora iteramos sobre os STAGES dinâmicos, não mais colunas fixas */}
                {stages.map(stage => {
                    // Filtra os deals desta coluna
                    // Nota: Idealmente filtramos pelo stageId. Se o backend ainda não salva stageId, usamos o status (code) como fallback
                    const columnDeals = deals.filter(d => 
                        d.currentStageId === stage.id || (!d.currentStageId && d.status === stage.code)
                    );
                    
                    const totalValue = columnDeals.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + Number(curr.value), 0);

                    return (
                        <KanbanColumn 
                            key={stage.id} // UUID do stage
                            id={stage.id}  // UUID usado pelo DragDrop
                            title={stage.name}
                            deals={columnDeals}
                            color={stage.color} // Cor vinda do banco
                            totalValue={totalValue}
                            onAddDeal={() => onAddDeal(stage.code as DealStatus)}
                            onEditDeal={onEditDeal}
                        />
                    );
                })}
            </div>
        </DragDropContext>
    );
};
